extraction_notes: S1Y is the 2000 V member of the S1AA-S1YA family; the table lists the S1Y marking under the 2000 V column.
The datasheet publishes typical reverse recovery time of 1.5 us under IF = 0.5 A, IR = 1.0 A, IRR = 0.25 A.
Curve points are manually digitized from the supplied plots and retain plotted axis scales and stated conditions.
omission_reason: No breakdown-voltage or breakdown-current specification is published beyond the maximum rated reverse voltage.
